text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "The Umamusume are about to reach the top of the hill! We've entered the critical moment of the race!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (――The race is unfolding faster than it feels...! In this situation, I can't let myself fall behind!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Then what I must recall is the experience of the optimal timing to make my move...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Position's good, stamina's good. Now's the time!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus is moving up!
Ikuno Dictus makes her move!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Ikuno Dictus takes the lead!
In the lead is Ikuno Dictus!!
She crosses the finish line in first place!!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Alright...—
Yes, yes...!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The best feeling I've ever had...!
I've got it down perfectly—this is my running——)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That's Ikuno Dictus's running style...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
Ikuno Dictus's racecraft today was magnificent, putting her past experience to use better than ever before...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Even I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That my running today...
has clearly taken a definite form...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictuuus!!
You were so ridiculously cool out there--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan B
text_block_list.text: That was such a powerful race!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you very much...!

Afterward, in the winner's interview,
Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"—So, it's confirmed that your next race
will be the Mile Championship!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—I will be in top form for the Mile Championship, without fail,
and seize victory just like I did today.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan A
text_block_list.text: Running both the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and the Mile Championship back-to-back with barely any break is insanely tough, but if anyone can do it, Ikuno Dictus can...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I just know they can pull it off...!
Watching the fans erupt at Ikuno Dictus's declaration, I could feel her reputation climbing even higher...!
Afterward, returning to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Hydration and nutrition are both good.
Condition post-stretching is also good.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Physically, she seems fine for now.

Ikuno Dictus's style of running relies on calling upon her past experiences in her mind and making full use of them.
The strain on her brain must be considerable as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that, having taken in nutritional support earlier,
I have recovered considerably.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Even so, in our future post-maintenance, it seems best to take more careful care of brain fatigue.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Feedback received.
Proceeding with revisions to the maintenance plan."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"I have also formulated a recovery plan
leading up to the Mile Championship. Please review it."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fumu――
It's going according to plan.
Let us proceed as we are.

...There is not a hint of instability
in Ikuno Dictus's post-race demeanor.
Watching her even brings a sense of relief.

Surely, running through this spring has changed
not just my running, but—

Her daily "maintenance" and "management" skills—
it's likely because she has polished them
even further.

Running both the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and the Mile Championship in a row
reaffirmed that this was also proof of the results
of her "management"—
choice_data_list: Alright... First, let's get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Let's prepare properly without rushing even more than before, and make plans for the Mile Championship.

"...And so, after securing a safe victory
in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—"
—Though the turnaround to the Mile CS was short, without rushing, restoring Ikuno Dictus's mental and physical energy was made the top priority.

—...And then, on a day when Ikuno Dictus
was steadily making her recovery...

We decided to hold another meeting
to prepare for the Mile CS—
choice_data_list: First, shall we check the participating Umamusume?

text_block_list.text: The foremost Umamusume to watch out for this time is surely Daitaku Helios, the high-tension party girl.

She has been showing an immense presence
in recent mile races.
There's no doubt she will be a formidable rival.

We also need to watch out for Yamanin Zephyr,
who clashed once with Ikuno Dictus
in this year's Yasuda Kinen.

Ikuno Dictus is definitely stronger now than she was back then,
but there is a possibility that her opponent has grown just as much.

Just because you've fought them in the past
doesn't mean you can let your guard down at all—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —And there's one person I'm personally curious about.

...Ikuno Dictus's friend,
Nice Nature, is also running in this race.

Synthesizing the information available right now,
Nice Nature's best distance seems to lean toward middle and long.
To be honest, her threat level in this race falls short compared to Daitaku Helios or Yamanin Zephyr, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Nature knows me very well.
Both my running and my personality.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So an opening might be caught
in an unexpected way.
We certainly can't afford to let our guard down in that regard.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...It is always a joy.
Having the opportunity to compete against a friend like this."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: More than anything else, that emotion comes out first.
choice_data_list: ...You could say that's a privilege reserved for you, who keeps on running.
...You could say that's a privilege reserved for you, who keeps on running.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: A privilege—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...You might be right.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Knowing that I'll have many more opportunities like this ahead... it puts real strength into every step forward."

—The culmination of Ikuno Dictus's mile campaign.
The Mile CS was fast approaching.
